description.en: Creates a high-detail ("hi model") dialogue character model from raw face/body model numbers, optionally set up for talking (a "Talk"-mode model).
Name to assign the created model.
Body model ID (also used as the shoes ID, and the glove ID when _keeper is true).
Optional; whether to use the home uniform variant (defaults to true).
Optional; whether the character is a goalkeeper (defaults to false).
Optional; whether to create it in "Talk" mode for dialogue (defaults to true).
Optional flag passed through to CMND_CREATE_CHARA (defaults to false).
Optional memory pool to allocate the model from (defaults to DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a high-detail dialogue model, not set up for talking
local hShindouH = CreateEvHiMdlForNumber("shindouH", 9, 1, true, false, false);
